about: The contact rules the engine (site_page.contact_problems, the email rule in html_problems) and Peek's lib/sample-page.ts must agree on. The contact/footer section starts at the first <footer> that is not inside a <blockquote> or <figure> (a quote's caption), or the first element whose id or class contains contact, visit, find, location or footer, and runs to the end of the page. There the business's own phone (text or tel:, compared on the last 10 digits), street (whitespace and case normalised), map link (no scheme, no www., no query or fragment, no end slash; a prefix of the row's is fine) and social profiles (the same normalising, equal) may appear; elsewhere the phone and street are refused, and anywhere a phone, street, map or profile not the lead's is refused. A wa.me link is never a phone. An email address is refused everywhere. 'refused' lists the kinds each page is refused for.
